appearancePaletteBody: 色板只提供种子，上屏的是 HCT 推导出的整套角色色。旧版没有自定义取色，因此这里也不提供。
The palette only supplies a seed; the screen shows the full HCT-derived role set. The legacy app had no custom picker, so there is none here.
appearanceBottomBarDragBody: 按住右侧把手或长按整行拖动排序，顺序即底栏从左到右的顺序。至少 2 项、最多 {max} 项：浮条按项数等比分配宽度，再多就挤到看不清图标。

Drag by the handle on the right or long-press a row to reorder; the order is the bottom bar order from left to right. Keep 2 to {max} items: the floating bar splits its width evenly and more would squeeze the icons.
appearanceBottomBarSelected: 已选 {count} 项，可配置 2–4 项
